description: This script manages the review lifecycle (start, stop, clear) for components based on their metadata.yaml files, specifically updating date fields related to review cycles.

methods.name: list_components
methods.description: Finds all components with metadata.yaml files excluding docs and scripts directories.

methods.name: show_help
methods.description: Displays usage information and available commands for the script.

methods.name: resolve_metadata
methods.description: Resolves the path to a component's metadata.yaml, validating its existence.

methods.name: add_business_days
methods.description: Adds a specified number of business days to a given date.

methods.name: clear_dates
methods.description: Clears review lifecycle date fields in a metadata.yaml file.

methods.name: regen_report
methods.description: Regenerates the RAG report for components.
